title: Decent pillow
text: Decent pillow. I think this pillow is great, but like all down products, it suffers from the feathers escaping the case problem.

product_metadata.title: WarmKiss Feather Pillows King Size Set of 2, Bed Medium Firm Pillows for Sleeping, Pillows Suitable for Side and Back Sleepers, Fluffy and Supportive Gusseted Pillow (20” x 36”)
features: 【SUPPORTIVE & FLUFFY 】: The 1.5" gusset design of WarmKiss’ king-size feather pillows two-pack keeps the structure and loftiness of the medium-firm pillows and provides the ache-free head and neck support you need, thereby making these feather pillows better for side sleepers than other bed pillows. WarmKiss’ hotel-quality feather pillows are filled with 95% feather and 5% down, which is supportive and fluffy, thereby creating a sound sleeping experience.

【NATURAL & HEALTHY】: WarmKiss’ king-size medium-firm pillows have obtained various safety and quality certifications, such as OEKO-TEX, DOWNPASS, BSCI, and RDS. They have not been tested on animals. Our down and feather have gone through 21 processes to ensure the filling cleanliness up to 1000+. WarmKiss provides you with odorless, and skin-friendly feather pillows.

【ALL SLEEPING POSITIONS】: Our two-pack of king-size medium-firm pillows have a perfect balance between fluffy and firm, thereby providing gentle support and adequate comfort for the head and neck, which makes them suitable for side, stomach, and back sleepers. They are beneficial to reduce back pain, neck pain, and shoulder pain.

【PRODUCT SIZE】: The size of our queen feather pillows is 18” x 26”; the size of our king feather pillows is 18” x 34”. Our king-size medium-firm pillows are vacuum-packed in a gift box. Our medium-firm pillow is an ideal gift for family and friends. (Note: Pillows may take up to 24 hours to fluff back to their original size before use.)

【CARE INSTRUCTIONS】: Machine-washable. Our feather pillows can be washed in cool water on the gentle cycle and tumble-dried on low. It is necessary to ensure that our pillows are completely dry, and that there is no clumping or odor before use. (Note: We recommended using pillowcases to protect your investment; this will make your pillows easier to clean and last longer.)
